summary: K&F Growth Acquisition Corp. II, a Cayman blank-check company, filed an 8-K reporting unsecured promissory notes issued September 18, 2026 to Daniel Fetters and Edward King, each for $300,000, totaling $600,000. The no-interest notes fund working capital and mature on the earlier of the initial business combination or liquidation, repayable outside the trust account. At the payees' option, principal may convert into private-placement-style units of one Class A share plus one-fifteenth of a right. Watch for business-combination timing, trust-account sufficiency and conversion-driven dilution overhang.
